exposure: Vaginal breech delivery (compared to vertex vaginal delivery)
outcome: Vaginal breech delivery / Breech presentation (as an outcome influenced by other factors)
cohort: The study included 1919 mothers who delivered vaginally in Orotta National Referral Teaching Hospital between January 1, 2019 and December 31, 2023, comprising cases of vaginal breech delivery and controls with vertex vaginal deliveries.
finding: Vaginal breech delivery was associated with a low first minute Apgar score, and factors such as address from other zobas, high gravidity, low birth weight, and multiple fetuses increased the risk of vaginal breech delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginal breech delivery was associated with a low first minute Apgar score.
followup_time: 1 minute after birth (for Apgar score), perinatal period (for stillbirth)
birth_weight: N/A (low birth weight and birth weight >3.4 kg were analyzed as variables, but overall birth weight range/mean of cohort not specified)
